facts.business: Blue Chip Tex Industries Limited is engaged in the textile manufacturing business.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is focused on liquidity management through cost reduction initiatives and working capital optimization with an aim of becoming a net debt-free Company in next 3 years.

key_risks: Inflation is expected to remain elevated for the foreseeable future
Infrastructure and logistics remain significant bottlenecks
Limited investment in research and development restricts innovation
Workforce lacks adequate training resulting in lower productivity
Fluctuations in raw material prices coupled with high import duties impact cost efficiency
Currency volatility and high interest rates add to financial burden
facts.related_party_note: Includes Rs 26.49 Lakhs (Previous Year Rs 3.44 Lakhs) from related party - Beekaylon Synthetics Private Limited
